name: Alejandra Avila
office: City of Baldwin Park, Member of the City Council

items.text: Alejandra Avila is a member of the Baldwin Park City Council. She has also served as the city's mayor. As of 2022, she had worked for the Baldwin Park Unified School District for 30 years. She was the city's clerk for nine years before joining the council in 2018.

sentences.text: Alejandra Avila is a member of the Baldwin Park City Council.
She has also served as the city's mayor.
As of 2022, she had worked for the Baldwin Park Unified School District for 30 years.
She was the city's clerk for nine years before joining the council in 2018.

items.text: In June 2025 she said, "As Mayor, I speak and advocate for all members of our community, including our undocumented immigrant residents." In October 2026 she voted against more than doubling council salaries, pointing to the city's low budget, pending litigation, and unresolved labor contracts. Avila also won support for a task force to address massage businesses she said have been linked to human trafficking.
